title: Edge cases — single bin, all-zero counts
description: Stress-tests the Histogram widget on degenerate inputs that valid lesson JSON might still contain: a single-bin histogram and a histogram with all-zero counts.

data.markdown: The schema only requires `binEdges.length === counts.length + 1`. It does NOT require the histogram to be "interesting" — single-bin and all-zero histograms are valid. They should render without crashing or producing console errors.
